DELIVERY_TRACKING.name: Order Delivery & Tracking
DELIVERY_TRACKING.definition: Questions regarding late delivery, tracking number updates, courier delays, or orders marked delivered but not received.

RETURNS_REFUNDS.name: Returns, Refunds & Replacements
RETURNS_REFUNDS.definition: Requests for returning an item, inquiring about refund progress, requesting replacement, or reporting damaged, broken, missing, or wrong items.

CANCELLATION_MODIFICATION.name: Order Cancellation & Modification
CANCELLATION_MODIFICATION.definition: Requests to cancel an existing order or change order parameters (delivery address, delivery slot, quantity, or shipping method) before dispatch.

PAYMENT_BILLING.name: Payment, Billing & Charges
PAYMENT_BILLING.definition: Issues regarding double charges, unexpected deductions, payment method failures, gift card balances, vouchers, promo codes, or invoice requests.

SUBSCRIPTION_PRIME.name: Prime & Digital Subscriptions
SUBSCRIPTION_PRIME.definition: Inquiries or issues regarding Amazon Prime membership, annual renewal charges, Prime Video / Music streaming errors, Kindle Unlimited, or subscription cancellation.

ACCOUNT_SECURITY.name: Account Access & Security
ACCOUNT_SECURITY.definition: Troubles logging in, password reset issues, two-factor authentication (OTP/2FA) failure, suspended/locked accounts, or suspected unauthorized account access.

PRODUCT_INQUIRY.name: Product & Stock Inquiry
PRODUCT_INQUIRY.definition: Questions regarding stock availability, restock dates, product compatibility, technical specifications, seller authenticity, or warranty coverage.

FEEDBACK_CHITCHAT.name: General Feedback & Pleasantries
FEEDBACK_CHITCHAT.definition: Expressions of gratitude, generic compliments, emotional rants/frustration without specific order context, or casual greetings.
